stories.headline: Ridgeline Creature Met; Purpose Confirmed; Survey Office Closes File With Unusual Warmth
stories.byline: By our Magical Creature Survey correspondent, filed Sunday evening
body: The creature known informally as 'the copper fox' and formally as Survey File AA-Amber-7 was encountered Sunday morning on the ridge trail above the hollow, at approximately half-past eight, when Christine and Steve's Jeep came around the final bend and stopped. The creature did not retreat. It sat in the middle of the trail and waited.

What followed, according to a Survey Office observer posted discreetly behind a sycamore, lasted four minutes and was described in the official close-out report as 'an exchange of mutual recognition between parties who already knew each other, one of whom had simply needed to confirm the other was still coming.' The creature approached the Jeep's passenger side. It looked at Christine. It made a sound the observer noted as 'not a bark and not quite a greeting, but something that functioned as both.' Then it stepped off the trail, turned once, and was gone into the tree line.

The Survey Office has now confirmed the creature's classification: a Locus Familiar — a rare form that bonds not to a single witch or wizard but to a practice, a habit, a repeated act of care on a specific piece of land. Trail records, when reviewed, show that Christine and Steve have cleared fallen branches, refilled a muggle water marker, and once pushed a stranger's bogged vehicle off the mud flat near the lower hollow without being asked and without leaving a name. 'It wasn't waiting for the Jeep,' the Survey Office's closing note reads. 'It was waiting to confirm the Jeep's owners were exactly who it thought they were. It has now confirmed this. File closed. Classification: Wholesome, Not Misc. — its own category, opened today.'

stories.headline: Monday Opens Promptly; Christine Opens Faster; the Week Advised to Proceed Accordingly
body: Gringotts opened its bronze doors at the customary Monday hour to find Christine already at her desk, account ledgers annotated, three client queries pre-resolved, and a diplomatic response to the Goblin Audit Committee drafted and awaiting signature. The Committee, which had sent its query at 7:52 a.m., received its response at 7:58 a.m. Two goblins read it twice. One said 'hm.' This is the closest the Audit Committee has come to a compliment in six years.

Head Goblin Ragnok confirmed this morning that Q3 client satisfaction figures are at a fourteen-year high. When asked to attribute the result, he looked at Christine's desk, said nothing, and walked away. The Department of Goblin-Wizard Relations has recorded this as a formal commendation. Christine was already on her second client.

stories.headline: Survey Office Opens 'Wholesome, Not Misc.' as Standalone Registry; Quoyne Provides Shelf; Shelf Is Level
body: Senior Archivist Quoyne confirmed Monday morning that the Magical Creature Survey Office's new 'Wholesome, Not Misc.' classification — opened yesterday to receive the Locus Familiar close-out file — has been allocated its own registry shelf in the Ministry's East Archive. Quoyne supplied the shelf from personal inventory. He has checked it twice with a spirit level and reports it is plumb in both directions.

The registry currently contains one file. The Survey Office expects this number to remain at one for some time, as Locus Familiar confirmations occur on average once per decade. 'We're not in a hurry,' the Office's statement reads. 'The category exists now. That's the point.' Ministry observers note that both the 'Wholesome, Misc.' volumes and this new registry are the only Ministry shelves that Quoyne has been observed to dust personally.

stories.headline: Monday Evening Reconvenes; Jeep Securely Parked; the Ridge Behind Them; the Week Ahead Negotiable
body: Christine and Steve returned from the ridge trail Sunday and spent the intervening hours in the customary fashion: the Jeep received a thorough mud assessment (Steve, approximately forty minutes), the account of the creature encounter was told once in full and once more because Ellie appeared to have missed the first telling, and the household settled into the particular Monday-eve quiet that follows a weekend that went exactly right.

Lucy spent the evening in a chair with a view of the door, which may or may not be related to weekend events and which she declined to discuss. Jersey achieved his preferred lap position by five-forty-seven and remained there through dinner, radiating contentment at an intensity the household has come to regard as a public service. The biscuit tin is accounted for. The ridge is behind them. Monday, advised of the week's opening conditions, has agreed to proceed at a reasonable pace.

familiars_corner: Lucy: Sat at the window all Sunday morning with an expression that suggested she knew something about the ridge creature before anyone else did and had simply chosen not to file a report. No evidence exists for this. This is, of course, precisely the point.

Ellie: Was told about the copper fox twice and both times responded with the same interested, slightly uncertain expression, which may mean she is processing the information carefully or may mean she has never previously considered that foxes have opinions. Either interpretation is plausible and both are fine.

Jersey: Approved of Sunday's outcome from his customary position on the sofa, where he had been maintaining the household in a state of ambient warmth for the duration of the expedition. He was available for a full debrief upon their return and offered his lap generously. This is his contribution. It is not a small one.
founding_editor_note: The Survey Office shelf is level, Quoyne, but if you'd let me hang it I'd have put a second bracket in the middle. Just saying. — D.

in_brief.sport: The Gringotts Vault-Carry Invitational has requested Christine attend as a guest judge; she has politely noted she has a full client slate, but her deadlift warm-up would constitute a personal record in three of the four weight categories.
in_brief.forecast: Monday mist lifting by mid-morning · the ridge quiet now · the hollow keeping its own counsel · ducks: one confirmed, direction unknown.

storyline_updates.title: The Autumn Creature Survey
storyline_updates.summary: Resolved Sunday, reported Monday. The Locus Familiar was encountered on the ridge trail and confirmed Christine and Steve as the trail-keepers it had been waiting for. Classification 'Wholesome, Not Misc.' opened as a standalone Ministry registry. File closed warmly. Quoyne's shelf is level.

storyline_updates.title: The New Registry
storyline_updates.summary: Day 1: The 'Wholesome, Not Misc.' registry has been opened at the Ministry with one file. Quoyne has shelved it personally and confirmed it is plumb. The question now circulating quietly: is there a second entry coming? Several Ministry departments have apparently reviewed their own recent unusual files with new interest. Day 2 should develop a candidate — a second case being considered for the category, perhaps something connected to Christine, Steve, or the household that a Ministry desk is quietly reviewing for possible reclassification.
